top_findings: Category pages lack substantive editorial content, relying solely on plant card listings
No BreadcrumbList schema markup on any page (visual breadcrumbs present, missing JSON-LD)
No meta robots tags for indexing control on any page
Blog index H1 is too generic ('Blog')
Google Fonts external dependency impacts Core Web Vitals (+150-300ms LCP)
No author bylines on blog posts (uses Organization as blanket author, weak E-E-A-T)
No responsive image srcset on plant images
Content collections configured but directories missing (build warnings)
Plant pages use generic @type:Thing schema instead of more specific types
Category count logic shows inflated numbers (bedroom/office categories filter loosely)
quick_wins: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema to Layout for instant rich snippet eligibility
Replace Google Fonts with self-hosted font files to eliminate external render-blocking request
Add meta robots 'index, follow' to Layout for explicit crawl control
Expand category page descriptions with 200-400 words of editorial content
Add srcset and sizes attributes to plant images for responsive loading

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Canonical URLs present on every page via Layout
robots.txt correctly configured with Allow: / and Sitemap link
Correct hreflang tags (en + x-default) on all pages
Clean URL structure with trailing slash removal (trailingSlash: 'never')
Sitemap integration via @astrojs/sitemap (30 pages generated at build time)
No broken internal links detected in source code
404 page properly implemented with navigation options
Build produces static HTML — no JS required for content rendering
Production build verified: 30 pages, 6.94s, clean

findings.title: No meta robots tags on any page
findings.description: No pages include <meta name='robots' content='...'> tags. While not strictly required (Google defaults to index,follow), explicit control is needed for pre-launch staging and future paginated/category pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a default 'index, follow' robots meta tag in Layout.astro. For staging environments, override to 'noindex, nofollow'.

findings.title: Content collections configured but directories missing
findings.description: src/content.config.ts references src/content/blog/ and src/content/plants/ directories that do not exist. Build emits warnings: 'base directory does not exist'. This indicates unused or stale configuration.
findings.recommendation: Either remove unused collections from content.config.ts or create empty directories to suppress warnings.

findings.title: No server-side security headers configured
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, or HSTS headers are configured. These must be set at the hosting/CDN level (e.g., Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel).
findings.recommendation: Configure security headers at the deployment platform level before going live.

findings.title: Sitemap only generated at build time, missing dev parity
findings.description: @astrojs/sitemap only produces output during 'astro build'. Pre-launch verification done: all 30 pages included in sitemap-0.xml.
findings.recommendation: Sitemap verified. No action needed pre-launch beyond confirming GSC submission.

findings.title: Trailing slash handling may cause redirect chains
findings.description: trailingSlash: 'never' works but if any external sites link to trailing-slash versions, users experience 301 redirect adding latency.
findings.recommendation: Monitor for trailing-slash redirects in Search Console post-launch.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All pages have unique, descriptive title tags (25-65 chars range)
All pages have unique meta descriptions (120-165 chars range)
H1 tags present and unique on every page
Semantic heading structure (H1 to H2 to H3) used throughout
Internal linking between plant pages, categories, and blog posts
Breadcrumb navigation present on blog posts, plant pages, and category pages

findings.title: Category pages are on-page SEO thin
findings.description: Category pages (low-light, bedroom, pet-safe, beginner, office) contain only a heading, short description, and a grid of plant cards. No editorial content, no unique keyword targeting, no FAQ or buying guidance. Category count logic for 'bedroom' and 'office' filters is overly broad.
findings.recommendation: Add 200-400 words of category-specific editorial content per page. Tighten category filter logic for bedroom/office.

findings.title: Blog index H1 too generic
findings.description: Blog index page H1 is simply 'Blog'. Misses opportunity to target informational keywords like 'Indoor Plant Care Blog' or 'Air Quality Articles'.
findings.recommendation: Change H1 to 'Indoor Plant Care & Air Quality Blog' and update title tag accordingly.

findings.title: Blog posts lack article OG metadata
findings.description: All pages use og:type 'website'. Blog posts should use og:type 'article' with article:published_time and article:author for proper social sharing.
findings.recommendation: Add og:type='article' to blog posts with article:published_time. Pass image prop for per-post OG images.

findings.title: Missing Twitter Card meta tags
findings.description: Only twitter:card 'summary_large_image' is set. Missing twitter:site and page-specific overrides.
findings.recommendation: Add twitter:site handle and ensure twitter:title/description are explicitly set.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T signals: mission page, methodology disclosure, source citations
NASA Clean Air Study cited as primary source with proper context about limitations
Realistic claims: 'never claim a single plant will cure indoor air pollution'
Blog posts are well-researched, 1000+ words with balanced perspectives
Unique content on every page — no duplicate content detected
Plant detail pages include care guides, toxin lists, benefits, and fun facts
Cross-referencing with ASPCA, Royal Horticultural Society, peer-reviewed journals

findings.title: No author bylines on blog posts
findings.description: All content is attributed to 'Air Purifying Plants Guide' (Organization). Google's E-E-A-T guidelines and AI citation algorithms favor content with named human authors, bios, and expertise signals.
findings.recommendation: Add author name, bio, and author schema to blog posts. Even a single editorial persona ('Alex Chen, Plant Biologist') adds significant E-E-A-T weight.

findings.title: Category pages lack editorial depth
findings.description: Five category pages exist but none contain original editorial content beyond a 1-sentence description. These are prime candidates for informational keyword targeting.
findings.recommendation: Write 200-400 words of editorial content per category page. Include guidance on choosing plants, common mistakes, and links to relevant blog posts.

findings.title: No internal linking strategy from blog to category pages
findings.description: Blog posts link to individual plant pages but not to category pages. Topic clustering (pillar to cluster) is not implemented.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual links from blog posts to relevant category pages (e.g., link 'bedroom plants' category from the how-many-plants-per-room article).

findings.title: About page not linked from main navigation
findings.description: About page is only linked in the footer. Main nav and mobile menu don't include it, reducing visibility for E-E-A-T signals.
findings.recommendation: Add 'About' link to the main navigation or ensure it's prominently linked from the homepage hero.

findings.title: No blog post update dates
findings.description: Blog posts have datePublished but lack dateModified in the visible content area and schema markup. Freshness signals are important for YMYL-adjacent content.
findings.recommendation: Add dateModified to blog post display and Article schema. Review and update dates quarterly.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema present on all pages via Layout
WebSite schema present on all pages via Layout
CollectionPage + ItemList schema on homepage with 15 plants enumerated
FAQPage schema on FAQ page with 8 QA pairs
Article schema on all 4 blog posts
Plant detail pages include PropertyValue annotations

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList schema on any page
findings.description: Breadcrumb navigation is visually present on blog posts, plant pages, and category pages, but BreadcrumbList JSON-LD is not implemented. This is a missed rich snippet opportunity.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList schema to Layout.astro. Breadcrumb structure is already in the HTML — just needs JSON-LD wrapper with dynamic generation from Astro.url.pathname.

findings.title: Plant pages use @type: Thing instead of more specific type
findings.description: The plant detail page schema uses @type Thing which is the most generic schema type.
findings.recommendation: Consider using @type Product (with category 'Houseplant') or a custom type with additional properties.

findings.title: Blog Article schema missing image property
findings.description: Blog post Article schemas don't include 'image' property, which helps Google display rich results in search.
findings.recommendation: Add 'image' property with URL to the post's hero/og-image to each blog post Article schema.

findings.title: No local business or publisher schema depth
findings.description: Publisher schema exists inside Article schemas but lacks full Publisher type with logo URL required for some rich result types.
findings.recommendation: Expand Organization schema with @type ['Organization', 'Publisher'] and ensure logo URL is included.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Images are lazy-loaded (loading='lazy') on plant cards
All plant images in WebP format
Minimal JavaScript footprint (only recommendation tool + mobile menu)
Tailwind CSS v4 with automatic purge-ready setup
preconnect hints for Google Fonts domain
Aspect-ratio containers on plant cards mitigate CLS

findings.title: Google Fonts is an external render-blocking resource
findings.description: Google Fonts CSS is loaded from fonts.googleapis.com. This is an external, render-blocking request that adds approximately 150-300ms to LCP, especially on slow connections.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Geist and Geist Mono fonts. Download the font files from GitHub and serve from /public/fonts/. Add @font-face declarations in global.css. Remove the Google Fonts link from Layout.astro.

findings.title: No image srcset for responsive loading
findings.description: All plant images use a single resolution. Mobile devices download the same file as desktop, wasting bandwidth.
findings.recommendation: Generate 2-3 image sizes (400w, 800w, 1200w) and use srcset + sizes attributes.

findings.title: No Resource Hints for critical assets
findings.description: Only Google Fonts has preconnect. No prefetch/prerender for likely next pages (e.g., top plant pages from homepage).
findings.recommendation: Add link rel='prefetch' for the top 3 plant pages on homepage. Consider prerendering the most likely click target.

findings.title: RecommendationTool inline script is large without async/defer
findings.description: The plant recommendation tool includes all plant data (approx 5KB JSON) in an inline script using is:inline. While this prevents processing, it still contributes to parse time.
findings.recommendation: Add defer attribute or explore using Astro's built-in client:load for off-thread execution.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: llms.txt file present with complete site structure (44 lines, all pages listed)
Rich schema markup throughout (FAQPage, Article, CollectionPage)
Clear, factual content with cited sources (NASA, EPA, ASPCA, peer-reviewed journals)
Question-answering format on FAQ page directly targets featured snippets
Well-structured heading hierarchy aids passage extraction
Authoritative outbound citations to primary research

findings.title: No author expertise signals for AI citation
findings.description: AI systems (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) weight content with named human authors higher for citation. Organization-only attribution reduces citability score.
findings.recommendation: Add named author with bio and expertise credentials to each blog post and plant guide. Even one recurring expert persona significantly improves AI citation readiness.

findings.title: llms.txt could include more granular section references
findings.description: Current llms.txt only lists top-level pages. For AI crawlers, more granular section references would improve citability.
findings.recommendation: Add section-level anchors to llms.txt (e.g., 'Snake Plant - Care Guide' with hash anchor) for better passage extraction.

findings.title: No brand mention monitoring setup
findings.description: No infrastructure exists to track brand mentions across AI platforms. Post-launch, monitoring citations in AI Overviews and ChatGPT responses is important.
findings.recommendation: Set up Google Alerts for 'Air Purifying Plants Guide' and periodically check brand mentions in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All 15 plant images in WebP format for modern compression
Alt text present on all img tags (descriptive, plant name)
Images stored in /public/images/plants/ with clean naming convention
Explicit width/height on plant detail page images (1200x900)
Lazy loading enabled on PlantCard component images
Aspect-ratio CSS on image containers mitigates CLS

findings.title: Missing responsive image srcset
findings.description: All 15 plant images serve a single resolution. No srcset or sizes attributes for responsive delivery.
findings.recommendation: Generate multiple sizes (400w, 800w, 1200w) and use img srcset pattern.

findings.title: No per-plant OG images for social sharing
findings.description: All pages use the same og:image (/og-image.jpg). When shared on social media, plant-specific pages lack a relevant visual.
findings.recommendation: Generate per-plant OG images using existing plant photos, or add plant name text overlay programmatically.

findings.title: RecommendationTool results use emoji instead of real plant images
findings.description: When users complete the recommender quiz, results show emoji icons instead of actual plant photos, reducing visual appeal and engagement.
findings.recommendation: Include a small thumbnail (the existing plant image) in recommendation results to increase engagement and click-through.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema to all pages via Layout.astro (dynamic generation from path)
Add meta robots 'index, follow' tag to Layout.astro for production readiness
Add named author with bio to blog posts for E-E-A-T signals
Remove unused content collections or create empty directories to silence build warnings
Verify sitemap output after build before deployment (confirmed: 30 pages)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand category pages with 200-400 words editorial content each
Self-host Google Fonts to eliminate external render-blocking request
Add responsive image srcset for all plant images
Update blog index H1 from 'Blog' to 'Indoor Plant Care & Air Quality Blog'
Add article:published_time and article:author OG meta tags to blog posts

phases.name: Phase 3: Content and Authority
items: Write 3-5 additional blog posts (targeting low-competition informational keywords)
Create internal linking strategy: blog posts to category pages to plant pages
Add 'About' link to main navigation for E-E-A-T visibility
Implement topic clusters with pillar page content
Replace generic schema @type:Thing on plant pages with @type:Product or richer type
Generate per-plant OG images

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring and Iteration
items: Monitor Google Search Console for indexation errors and sitemap coverage
Track brand mentions in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity
Add user engagement tracking (clicks on plant cards, recommender tool usage)
Plan seasonal content updates (e.g., 'Best Winter Indoor Plants')
Periodically check Core Web Vitals via PageSpeed Insights once live
Add blog pagination when content exceeds 10 posts
